exam_suitability.notes: Short and quick, about 75 seconds. The only arithmetic is trivial. The key is the first option and is not longer than the others. The calculator designation is consistent.

review.summary: The item passes all five criteria. It has a unique correct answer, distinct distractor misconceptions, appropriate scope and a short reading load.

difficulty.label: exam_prep
difficulty.rationale: Student must choose Archimedes' principle and see that buoyant force depends only on displaced fluid volume (rho_water*V*g), not object mass or density. Includes a liter-to-m^3 conversion and a simple computation (19.6 N). Distractors target common misconceptions (F_B = weight because at rest, mass dependence, density dependence). Short reading, minimal arithmetic, all in Unit 8 scope; difficulty comes from legitimate conceptual discrimination.
